name: ising_critical_slowing
claim: Under single-spin Metropolis on the 2-D Ising model, the integrated autocorrelation time of |m| grows with lattice size at Tc = 2.269 with fitted exponent z >= 1.5 (L = 4..16), while at T = 3.0 its exponent is below 0.5.
refute_if: z(Tc) < 1.5 OR z(T=3.0) >= 0.5 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds; INCONCLUSIVE if tau(Tc, L=16) < 5x the shuffled-series floor at >=2 of 5 seeds
recorded_not_graded: G7: at T = 1.5 both an ordered start and a random start are run and both tau values recorded
